scope: Independent tiny-fixture review of new inspectAxisPlanning Python bridge boundary only

finding.title: Rehashed facade snapshot can publish an inconsistent source/window binding
cases: requested_access_ras.center_mm differs from requested cached window
access.radius_mm differs from requested cached window
source_frame differs from current cached case
source_shape differs from current cached case
native_affine_ras_mm differs from canonical current cached affine
finding.mechanism: The bridge checks source identity strings and self-consistent hashes, but does not compare these returned binding fields to the actual current-session source/window. Fault-injected facade snapshots with changed binding fields and recomputed binding/report hashes are published as success.
finding.scope_limit: Internal facade fault-injection only; renderer-supplied reports are already rejected. No claim of an externally reachable patient-data exploit.
finding.expected_remedy: Check returned canonical source/frame/shape/access against the exact cached inputs, retaining only documented LPS unit-normal roundoff tolerance.
finding.resolution: The bridge now joins returned source ID/frame/shape/canonical affine, typed requested access and native access/conversion to its actual cached inputs; checks its fixed preset, reward/world/proposal contracts; and checks the returned hash against any explicit expectedBindingHash.

final_validation.scope: Tiny synthetic fixture boundary validation; no patient inference, public inspection, native benchmark, or packaging execution.

additional_initial_validation.finding: An internally resealed binding with changed max_steps was published despite a supplied expectedBindingHash that differed from the returned binding hash.

confirmed_properties: Returned source/window/frame and fixed-model mismatches are withheld even when the report is self-consistently rehashed.
Translated anisotropic LPS and RAS cases produce matching canonical window, native affine, source-grid hashes and action geometry.
Both acknowledgments fail to override full-head support prohibition or pending structural-envelope review.
Expanded case-byte admission occurs before numerical inspection.
A cached window changed after complete inventory construction withholds that inventory.
A timeout after complete inventory construction emits one terminal error and suppresses any late result.
Cancellation at the final progress boundary emits one terminal cancellation and no result.
Timeout and cancellation install no run/replay state; timeout preserves transfer files.
reviewed_owner_coverage: Strict request-key and native catalog checks; one/two distinct declared instruments in server order.
Source-voxel, case-array, provenance metadata and complete-response size caps.
No preview action installation in current-session route IDs, candidate/run state or files.
Promoted/partial report refusal and source/route staleness checks.
limits: The additional malformed-report tests inject faults inside the trusted Python facade, not through the renderer.
JSON self-consistency checks are not external cryptographic authentication or independent native geometry validation.
The input/output limits do not establish a peak-RSS cap; cancellation drains at cooperative boundaries.
No patient-scale latency, clinical safety, anatomical accuracy or cortical access approval is established.
